title: Thunderbird Marina
specs: Located 4 miles south of The Sagamore and 4 miles north of Lake George Village
Marina is easy to get to and provides a safe harbor
Driver must be at least 18yrs. old with a valid ID
Must view Lake George Boater’s Safety Video on premises prior to rental
includes: U.S. Coast Guard-approved safety equipment including life jackets, fire extinguishers, anchor/line, signal flares and whistle/horn
gap: Duration of jetski rentals not stated explicitly
blurb: Thunderbird Marina offers jetski and boat rentals including pontoon and bowrider boats. Jetskis accommodate 1 or 2 passengers and require a $500 deposit. Renters must be at least 18 years old with a valid driver's license and view a Lake George Boater’s Safety Video on premises before rental.
extraNote: $500 deposit required for jetski rentals · All deposits are released if no damages · Credit card required to confirm reservation with 50% non-refundable deposit at booking · If cancellation is more than 14 days prior to arrival, $50 processing fee and one night’s deposit forfeited; if 14 days or less, total amount forfeited · No refunds for early departure · Located at The Villas On Lake George
